rows.text: empanelled as L1 bidder by Lakshadweep Electricity Department for 3 years, rooftop solar + BESS on government buildings (2,107 kW + 5,525 kWh; contract value not yet communicated).
H1 FY27 total income Rs 53.60 cr, PAT Rs 5.01 cr.
receives a Letter of Award from the BSF to install 25 kWp off-grid solar power plants at 13 border outposts in Gujarat, for **Rs 4.03 crore**, over 12 months (SME).
receives a **Letter of Award** from Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam for a Rs 44.76 crore rooftop-solar EPC contract (8,000 consumers under PM-Surya Ghar) with 5+5 years of O&M
received a Letter of Award from BSF (Gujarat Frontier) to install 25 kWp off-grid solar plants at 16 border outposts, with battery rooms, worth **Rs 4.89 crore** over 12 months.
